def design(feats):
    # Create a mapping from feature id to its statistics
    # Based on the problem description, we'll prioritize features 
    # by their position in the ranked list (first 20 features)
    
    # Use the first 20 features as candidates (based on ranking in problem description)
    candidates = list(feats.ids[:20])
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated pairs with |r| >= 0.6)
    correlated_pairs = [
        ('LBV14', 'BRF16'), ('FWIC14', 'DNM11'), ('NXUR3', 'DLW17'),
        ('RQV6', 'LBV14'), ('WUY9', 'BRF16'), ('FWIC14', 'DXJE5'),
        ('DXJE5', 'DNM11'), ('LBV14', 'NHR5'), ('CWWV6B', 'LBV14'),

        ('WUY9', 'DNM11'), ('RQV6', 'BRF16')
    ]
    
    # Build set of candidate features
    feature_set = set(candidates)
    
    # Remove children in correlated pairs to prefer parents

    drivers = tuple(sorted_remaining[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # Columns include all selected features

    # Products: none for now

    loadings = {}
    for fid in columns:
        pos = feats.column(fid)
